method: Each listed item was read with its stem, all options, keyed answer(s), explanations and takeaway. Statuses are manually reasoned, not inferred from a schema or automated pass rule.
limitations: Independent AI editorial/clinical-reasoning screen; not external clinician validation or psychometric validation.
Pass applies only to the recorded content hash. New or changed content requires further review.
No comparison against proprietary examination items; originality judged from author provenance and item content.
Cross-bank learning-objective overlap remains provisional until all batches are available.
Source checks below support only the explicitly associated claims; other category references are general reading unless specifically verified.

items.assessment: No urgent retention is present, so privacy and usual safe position address the observed barrier before invasive catheterization. Partly open curtain now tests privacy-versus-observation balance.
Easy-release clothing directly addresses observed button delay. Scheduling at staff breaks and recording a diary alone do not immediately remove the functional barrier.
Moving some fluid earlier addresses diary-documented nocturnal volume while preserving hydration. Daytime scheduling alone is now a plausible mismatched response.
Supporting urinal position addresses weak grip. Scheduled access without holding help does not resolve device handling; spillage need not mean incontinence.
Routine gentle external care and a closed drainage system are appropriate. Unindicated antiseptics/antibiotic ointments are plausible over-treatment misconceptions.
Burning with an active leak needs prompt removal/skin-seal assessment; delayed scheduled change or tape concealment prolongs exposure. Post-meal timing is not asserted to be clinically desirable.
Reduced swelling with exposed skin calls for remeasurement and refit. Paste without correcting the opening is a realistic workaround that does not resolve fit.
Checking a new itch for leakage and demonstrating pouch emptying/closure show practical learning. Taping over a leak is a meaningful error; possessing a handout is not performance.
